title: COMMAND YOUR BLESSINGS TO LOCATE YOU EVERY MORNING WITH THIS PRAYER
text: Stop. Do not move. The Lord just arrested this moment. Before you understood what was happening, heaven already shifted on your behalf. That tongue that broke out of me, it was not for me. It was for you. It was a decree. It was an announcement. It was heaven telling hell, this one is not yours. Listen, I need you to understand something before we go one step further. You did not find this word, this word found you. God is deliberate. God is [music] intentional. God does not waste a moment. The fact that you are sitting where you are sitting, holding what you are holding, with this message in front of your eyes, that is not coincidence. That is a divine appointment. That is heaven keeping a promise it made over your life before you were born. And I want you to do something right now before we go any further. Reach for your phone. Reach for your tablet. Reach for whatever device is near you. Do not wait until the end of this ministration. Share this word now. Not because it is a good video. Not because the preacher is eloquent, but because the spirit of God has positioned you as a courier of heaven in this hour. There is someone in your contact list right now who has been crying in secret. There is someone who went to bed last night not knowing if the morning was worth waking up for. There is someone whose blessing has been running around looking for them and cannot find them. And God has chosen you, not an angel, you to be the instrument that redirects that blessing. Sharing this word is an act of obedience. It is not promotion. It is not social media activity. It is you fulfilling your assignment as a citizen of the kingdom. Share it now. And then come back because what God is about to do in this room is irreversible. Now, hear me. Open your spirit. Open the ears of your understanding. I want to go to Deuteronomy chapter 28 verses 1 and 2. And I want you to read it not with your eyes, with your spirit. And it shall come to pass, if thou shall hearken diligently unto the voice of the Lord thy God, to observe and to do all his commandments which I command thee this day, that the Lord thy God will set thee on high above all nations of the earth. And all these blessings shall come on thee and overtake thee if thou shall hearken unto the voice of the Lord thy God. Did you catch that? Did you catch the grammar? It says, all these blessings shall come on thee. Shall come on thee. Not you shall go find them. Not you shall climb high enough to reach them. Not you shall negotiate for them. They shall come on thee. This is the revelation that breaks poverty thinking. This is the revelation that demolishes the theology of the beggar. You were never designed to chase your blessings. You were designed [music] to position yourself and your blessings were designed to locate you. Now, go with me to Psalm 23 verse 6. David said, surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life. Follow me. Not I shall follow goodness. Not I shall spend my life pursuing mercy. He said, goodness and mercy are following me. They are tracking me. They are on my trail. They are assigned to my address. The question is not whether your blessings exist. The question is, are you positioned to receive them when they arrive? And then one more, Isaiah chapter 45 verse 2. God speaking to Cyrus, but here it has God speaking to you. I will go before thee and make the crooked places straight. I will break in pieces the gates of brass and cut in sunder the bars of iron. God says, I will go before thee. Before you arrive at the door, he's already working the locks. Before you step into the room, he has already rearranged the furniture. Before you open your mouth, he has already moved the hearts of the people you are about to meet. There are dimensions to this that the average believer has never accessed. Most believers are living as if they must fight for every blessing. Most believers wake up every morning in a defensive posture as if the world is against them. But the man or woman who understands divine positioning does not wake up fighting. They wake up commanding. Listen carefully. There is a difference between a prayer that begs and a prayer that commands. There is a difference between a prayer that asks and a prayer that decrees. There is a difference between a prayer that hopes and a prayer that enforces covenant. Jesus said in Matthew chapter 18 verse 18, whatsoever you shall bind on earth shall be bound in heaven and whatsoever you shall loose on earth shall be loosed in heaven. He did not say, whatsoever you beg heaven to bind. He did not say, whatsoever you hope heaven loosens for you. He said, whatsoever you shall bind, whatsoever you shall loose. He delegated [music] the authority. He released the legal power of heaven into the mouths of believers. And then he said, heaven will back you up. This is not theology. This is encounter. I am not standing here to give you information. I am standing here because the spirit of God is saying something right now to someone in this room. And what he's saying is this, stop [music] chasing. Start commanding. Hear me, this is not arrogance. This is not presumption. This is the posture of the son who knows who his father is. When you know your father owns the cattle on a thousand hills. When you know your father controls the hearts of [music] kings. When you know your father breathed the stars into existence. Then you do not go to the morning with your head bowed in defeat. You go to the morning with a word in your mouth and fire in your belly. Romans chapter 4 verse 17 tells us that God and by extension his children call it those things which be not as though they were. This is the creative power of the spoken word. This is the same power that was at work in Genesis chapter 1. God did not pray that the earth would be formed. God said, let there be light. God said, let the waters be gathered. God said, let the earth bring forth. And in Genesis chapter 1 verse 26, God said, let us make man in our image after our likeness. Not similar. Not close. In our image. That means the same creative power that formed galaxies was placed inside you. You were built to speak things into existence. You were built to call things that are not as though they are. You were built to command the morning. Job chapter 38 verse 12. God asked Job, hast thou commanded the morning since thy days and caused the day spring to know his place? God is asking Job, have you learned to command the morning? Have you learned to take authority over your day before your day takes authority over you? Have you learned that the morning is not neutral? It is either submitted to your voice or submitted to the enemy's agenda. The spirit of God is saying something right now. He is saying you have been allowing your mornings to be hijacked. You wake up and immediately anxiety speaks. You wake up and the first voice you hear is the voice of yesterday's failure. You wake up and before you open your mouth, the enemy has already assigned the atmosphere of your day. But that ends today. Thus saith the spirit of God, the morning belongs to you. The day was not created to rule you. You were created to rule the day. I need you to stay with me. Because what I am about to take you into is not just information. It is activation. It is alignment. It is the unlocking of a dimension of authority that has [music] been dormant in your life. Proverbs chapter 8 verse 17, wisdom says, I love them that love me and those that seek me early shall find me. Those that seek me early. There is something about the early hours that heaven has marked. >> [music] >> There is something about the first moments of the day that carries prophetic weight. The enemy knows this. That is why he sends his most aggressive assignments in the early hours. That is why people wake up with dread before they can explain why they feel it. The enemy is trying to contaminate your morning before the king arrives. But we are about to change that. We are about to take on the early hours. We are about to command our blessings to locate us not at noon. Not in [clears throat] the afternoon. Every morning. I decree and declare over every life under the sound of this voice. The morning is yours. The first light is yours. Every blessing that has been circling your life unable to land, I command it to land. By the power of the blood of Jesus, land. Now. There are dimensions to this that the average believer has never accessed. The average believer prays reactively. They pray when they are in trouble. They pray when they are desperate. They pray when the emergency arrives. But the apostolic believer, the kingdom citizen who has been trained in spiritual warfare, prays preemptively. They pray before the attack launches. They pray before the problem manifests. They command the day before the day begins. Psalm 5 verse 3. David said, my voice shall thou hear in the morning, O Lord. In the morning will I direct my prayer unto thee and will look up. >> [music] >> He said, in the morning I will direct my prayer. The word direct means to set in order. To arrange. To align. He was not saying, in the morning I will ramble at God. He was saying, in the morning I will set the spiritual order of my day. I will arrange the atmosphere. I will align the blessings. I will position my life for what God has prepared. This is the prayer general secret. This is why the great men and women of God who have walked in extraordinary breakthroughs, they all had one thing in common. They commanded the morning. Someone under the sound of my voice right now, you have been waking up at 3:00 a.m. for the past several weeks and you do not know why. You think it is stress. You think it is anxiety. You think something is wrong with you. The Lord says, I am the one waking you. I am calling you to an altar you have been avoiding. [music] The 3:00 a.m. prayer assignment on your life is not a burden, it is an honor. The Lord says, [music] "Answer the call and I will show you things in the night season that will transform your entire generation." [music] Now, I want everyone, everyone within the sound of this voice to rise. If you are able to rise, lift your hands. Lift them high. Open your palms to heaven not because you are begging, but because you are a son, you are a daughter. And a son does not beg at the table of his father. [music] A son commands from a position of inheritance. Let us pray. Father, Father, Father, we come before you not as strangers at a gate. We come as citizens of your kingdom. We come as sons and daughters of the Most High. We come carrying the blood of Jesus and that blood speaks better things than the blood of Abel. Hebrews 12:24, that blood is speaking right now. It is speaking access. It is speaking authority. It is speaking [music] covenant. And Father, we are entering this prayer on the back of that covenant. We thank you, Lord. We thank you because you are Jehovah Jireh, the God who sees and provides before the need is expressed. We thank you because you are El Shaddai, the God of more than enough. We thank you because you are Jehovah Nissi, our banner of victory. We thank you because you are Adonai, the Lord over every principality and every power. And now, Father, we take authority. Destiny, I speak to destiny right now. Every destiny under the sound of this voice that has been scattered, gather. Every destiny that has been delayed by demonic manipulation be accelerated now. Every God-ordained purpose that the enemy tried to abort life, >> [music] >> I speak to your calling. I speak to your assignment. I speak to the reason God created you. Jeremiah 29:11, the plans God has for you are good. They are plans for a future. They are plans for hope. And I decree that those plans come into full manifestation in the name of Jesus. Every altar erected against your destiny, I pull it down by fire. Every satanic counter assignment against your purpose, I arrest it now by the blood of Jesus. Every voice that has been speaking failure over your life, I silence it. Every prophetic word spoken by witches and warlocks against your tomorrow, I nullify it. >> [music] >> By the power of the Holy Ghost, nullify, nullify, nullify. Now, I speak to family. Every household under the sound of this voice, I cover you with the blood. Every marriage that is under attack, I speak peace. Every home that the enemy has turned into a battlefield, I decree it becomes a sanctuary. Every parent who has been watching their children go the wrong way, weeping in private, the Lord says, "Your tears have not been wasted. Your intercession has been filing up in bowls before the throne." Revelation 5:8, "And heaven is about to tip those bowls. Your prodigals are coming home by fire, by force, by the sovereign mercy of God, I break every generational curse over bloodlines connected to this word. Every covenant your ancestors entered knowingly or unknowingly that has been haunting your generation, I annul it tonight by the blood of Jesus. Every ancestral altar that was erected over your family name, I pull it down. Every demonic inheritance that has been passed from parent to child, from generation to generation, it stops here. It stops with you. It stops now. Galatians 3:13, Christ has redeemed us from the curse of the law, having become a curse for us. You are redeemed. [music] Enforce it. There is a woman, I see her, she has been believing God for her marriage. She has been standing, praying, weeping, fasting. She has almost quit. She told herself last month, "Maybe this is not for me." The Lord says, "Do not let go." I decree over that marriage divine realignment. I decree over that spouse a sovereign visitation. The Lord says, "What he joined together, no devil in hell is strong enough to separate. What is yours is coming back." I speak to marriage. Every marriage that was divinely ordained but has been disrupted by third-party interference, be healed. Every marriage struggling with communication, with trust, with intimacy, I decree restoration. Every single person who has been waiting for their divine spouse, I speak a supernatural alignment. The right person, the God-ordained vessel, is being prepared and positioned. No weapon of wrong connection formed against your covenant marriage shall prosper. Now, I speak to finances. I speak to the financial gates over every life under this voice. Every financial embargo, I lift it now. Every spiritual padlock on the gates of prosperity, I break it by the name of Jesus. Every poverty spirit that has followed your bloodline, it is cast out. Receive it. Say it cast out. Malachi 3:10, God says, "Bring all the tithes into the storehouse that there may be meat in mine house and prove me now here," with said the Lord of hosts, "if I will not open you the windows of heaven and pour you out a blessing that there shall not be room enough to receive it." I [music] decree the windows of heaven are open over your life. I decree the rebuke of the devourer is active over your finances. Every debt that has been strangling your destiny, I command supernatural discharge. Every business that the enemy has been suffocating, breathe. Every career that has been suppressed by invisible hands, be supernaturally promoted. [music] Every contract that has been delayed, be released. Every door that has been closed against your financial advancement, open. I decree [music] unexpected income, unexplained favor, unprecedented [music] acceleration. Michael, wherever you are, that financial embargo that has held your destiny hostage, it breaks right now by fire. Three years of waiting, three years of wondering, >> [music] >> three years of watching others move while you stood still. The Lord says, "Your season has changed. Your season changed the moment you press play on this word. Watch, the evidence will appear within 72 [music] hours." I speak to health. Every sickness, every disease, every infirmity that has taken residence in a body that God has declared the temple of the Holy Ghost, you are an illegal occupant. You have no lease. You have no covenant. You have no rights. By the blood of Jesus, leave. Isaiah 53:5, "By his stripes we are healed." Past tense, already done, already paid for. The healing was purchased at Calvary. It is not on layaway. It is not coming in the future. It is done. It is finished. It is yours. Receive it now. Every cancerous cell, I speak death to it by the blood of Jesus. Every fibroid, shrink in the name of Jesus. Every organ that medical science has declared nonfunctional, I speak life. Ezekiel 37, the dry bones came together. The breath entered. They lived. [music] I speak to every part of your body that has been in the valley, live. Every heart condition, healed. Every blood disorder, purified by the blood of Jesus. Every neurological condition, I speak divine rewiring, supernatural healing. Every chronic pain that has made a home in your body, I evict it tonight. There is a man, I see him in his 60s. He has been told by doctors that his kidneys are failing. He has not told his family the full picture because he does not want to frighten them. He has been carrying this in silence. The Lord says to that man, "I see you. I know the report, but I am not the doctor. I am Jehovah Rapha. I am the Lord [music] who heals." And I decree tonight those kidneys are restored. New kidneys by the power of the living God. Go back for the test. Go back for the scan. The report has changed. Now, let us deal with witchcraft. Every witchcraft assignment dispatched against the listeners of this word, I scatter it now by fire. Every monitoring spirit assigned to track your movement, to steal your breakthroughs, to report your progress to demonic altars, I blind it. I bind it. I cast it out. Every evil covenant that was entered on your behalf by someone who does not have authority to enter covenants for you, it is annulled. By the blood of Jesus, it is annulled. Every coven that has been meeting to deliberate on your downfall, their meeting is disbanded. Their verdict is overturned. Their assignment is reversed. Isaiah 54:17. No weapon formed against thee shall prosper, and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment, thou shalt condemn. Let the fire of the Holy Ghost fall on every witchcraft altar carrying your name. Let the fire of God consume every sacrifice made against your destiny. Let the fire of God incinerate every portrait, every photograph, every garment used in occult rituals against you. It burns by fire. Now, I speak to angels. Hebrews 1:14. Are they not all ministering spirits sent forth to minister for them who shall be heirs of salvation? The angels are assigned to you. They are waiting for a word. Psalm 103:20. Bless the Lord, ye his angels, that [music] excel in strength, that do his commandments, hearkening unto the voice of his word. They hearken to the voice of his word, and I release that word now. Angels, be activated over every life connected to this prayer. Angels of breakthrough be released. Angels of divine connection be activated. Angels of protection surround every household. Angels of provision go ahead into this week. Prepare the table. Prepare the encounters. Prepare the favor. I speak to time. Every stolen year, I call it back. Joel 2:25. And I will restore to you the years that the locusts have eaten. The locusts ate some years. The palmerworm stole some seasons. There were windows of opportunity that the enemy slammed shut. There were doors that were opened >> [music] >> and then closed before you could walk through. But we serve the God who lives outside of time. And what he restores does not look like the original. It exceeds the original. >> [music] >> I decree time restored. Seasons accelerated. Years redeemed. Joy. I see your name, Joy. The Lord says your womb is opening. The child you will carry will carry nations. The child you will carry will stand before kings. The doctor said one thing, the Lord says another thing. I decree life. Life. Life over that womb. Now, I speak to virtue. Everything the enemy stole from your childhood, gifts, creativity, confidence, joy, innocence, I command it returned. Everything the enemy took from your adolescence, dreams, faith, purity, vision, I command it returned. Everything stolen from your young adult years, opportunities, relationships, financial seeds that should have grown, returned >> [music] >> by the authority of the blood of Jesus. There is a young man I see him. He almost gave up on his purpose last [music] week. He sat in a room by himself. He looked at everything he had tried. [music] Everything that had not worked. He whispered the thought, "Maybe God did not really call me." The Lord saw you in that room. The Lord says, "I have not forgotten you. I have not passed you over. I have not revised my assignment for your life. The delay was not denial. >> [music] >> The silence was not rejection. I was preparing the table, and the table is ready. Rise. Shake off the dust. [music] It is your time. I speak divine preservation over every [music] life, over every family, over every ministry connected to this word. Psalm 121. He that keepeth thee will not slumber. Your keeper is awake. Your keeper is watching. Your keeper is active. No accident. No premature death. No untimely departure. No evil shall befall thee. No plague shall come near thy dwelling. >> [music] >> Psalm 91. It is active over your life right now. I speak open doors. Revelation 3:8. I have set before thee an open door, and no man can shut it. No man can shut it. No demon can shut it. No envy. No witchcraft. No betrayer. What God has opened, it stays open. I decree supernatural open doors this week. Calls that have been waiting. Meetings that have been delayed. Emails that have been sitting in inboxes waiting for someone to make a decision. Let the decision be made. Let the favor be released. Let the connections be activated. Let the divine helpers show up. The ones whose names you do not even know yet. Let them find you. There is a woman I see Lagos. Her name begins with C. She has been struggling with shame. Something happened in her past that she has never told anyone. She has carried it as a weight that has kept her from stepping into what God has called her to. >> [music] >> The Lord says to her, "I know the full story. I know every chapter they do not know. And my verdict is not shame. My verdict is glory. I am going to use the very thing the enemy meant to destroy you with as your testimony. Rise, daughter. The barrenness, spiritual and natural, is over. I decree life. Father, we thank you. We thank you because this prayer was not random. This was a divine appointment. This was a heavenly summons. Every person who engaged with this word was chosen for this moment. I command every blessing that has been waiting for this moment of alignment, locate the hearer of this word. Every morning from this morning forward, let the blessings arrive before the sun does. Let the favor walk through the door before the person does. Let the breakthrough announce itself before it is asked for. We decree and declare this is a new era. This is a new frequency. This is a new dimension of authority from this altar, from this moment. The morning belongs to the sons of God. Shondai Tumbalare Ecclesia Kai Tumbala Shondai Re Tumbala Kai Ecclesia Tumbalare Shondai. The siege is over. Do you hear what heaven is saying? >> [music] >> The siege is over. The prolonged waiting that felt like abandonment, it was preparation. The confusion that felt like God had forgotten your address, it was positioning. And now the positioning is complete. [music] Walk into your favor. It has been waiting. It has been standing at the door with your name on it. It has been going before you, clearing the road, pushing the obstacles aside. And now you are stepping into the corridor that was built for your feet. Your destiny is preserved by the blood. No devil in hell has the authority to repossess what the blood has purchased. No witch. No warlock. No principality. No power. Romans 8:38 and 39. Neither death nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come, nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate you from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord. I decree this week is not ordinary. This is not just another 7-day cycle. This week is your testimony. Something is going to happen this week that you will not be able to explain with natural language. Something is going to shift. Something is going to open. Something is going to arrive. And when it does, remember this altar. Remember that you commanded it. Remember that heaven backed you up. From this altar, you go as a carrier of the glory. You go as a representative of the kingdom. You go as one who has been in the presence and cannot leave unchanged. >> [music] >> And to the one who is reading this, watching this, holding this, the one who was supposed to share it before they consumed it. Go back. Fulfill your assignment. Someone is waiting. >> [music] >> Someone is on the edge. Someone needs what you carry. You are the instrument. You are the carrier. You are the vessel. Do not keep the fire to yourself. Shondai Ecclesia [music] Tumbalare Kai Shondai Tumbalare Ecclesia Rekai Tumbalare Shondai Ecclesia. [music] It is done. It is settled. It is sealed by the blood. Heaven has [music] recorded this decree, and hell has received notice. You are blessed going out. >> [music] >> You are blessed coming in. Your morning is commanded. Your blessings have your address. Go in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost. Amen.
